_provenance.title: تتمة دانيال — سوسنة وبيل والتنين (Daniel Additions: Susanna and Bel and the Dragon)
_provenance.translation_basis: Arabic source Arabic Bible (SVD), as published in the Coptic Treasures interactive verse-by-verse interface (chapter 13 = Susanna; chapter 14 = Bel and the Dragon).
_provenance.note: Sourced because Arabic source's structured Bible search has Daniel limited to 12 chapters and does not include the Greek Septuagint additions (Susanna, Bel and the Dragon, Song of Three Youths). Coptic Treasures publishes the SVD-translated additions under the URL slug 'daniel-ending'. The Song of Three Youths is omitted here because English integrates it inline in Daniel 3:24-90; our en/DAG.json contains only Susanna (DAG.1) and Bel (DAG.2).
